evals.prompt: Show me how to log into the SpeechLab dev API and get a JWT token I can use for requests. I'm writing a Node.js script.
evals.expected_output: Code that calls POST /auth/login and extracts the token from tokens.accessToken.jwtToken (NOT tokens.access.token). Should include the correct nested path.

assertions.text: Uses tokens.accessToken.jwtToken to extract the JWT (not tokens.access.token)
Calls POST /auth/login
Sets Authorization header as Bearer token

evals.prompt: I need to create a test project in SpeechLab without uploading a real file. How do I do it using the YouTube import feature?
evals.expected_output: Two-step flow: POST /uploads/import-youtube → POST /projects/createProjectAndTranscribe. Should mention fileUuid extraction and cleanup with isDeleted:true.

assertions.text: Uses POST /uploads/import-youtube
Uses POST /projects/createProjectAndTranscribe
Mentions fileUuid extraction from response
Mentions cleanup (isDeleted: true)

evals.prompt: Our POST /v1/dubs/merge endpoint keeps returning 502 Bad Gateway. What could cause that?
evals.expected_output: Should identify that beginDubJob is not exported from dub.service.js (issue #1846). The controller imports it via destructuring but it's missing from module.exports, so it's undefined and calling it throws TypeError.

assertions.text: Mentions beginDubJob not being exported
References issue #1846
Mentions module.exports or export

evals.prompt: I want to check if a user has enough credits to upload a 2-minute video before I let them proceed. What API call do I make?
evals.expected_output: POST /dubs/check-upload-billing with uploads: [{ duration: 120, filename: 'video.mp4' }]. Should explain 200=allowed, 402=insufficient credits.

assertions.text: Uses POST /dubs/check-upload-billing
Passes duration: 120 (2 minutes = 120 seconds)
Explains 402 response for insufficient credits

evals.prompt: When I call GET /translations/:id, what field contains the array of dubs? I keep looking for 'dubs' but it's not there.
evals.expected_output: The field is named 'dub' (singular), not 'dubs'. Via GET /translations/:id it returns 'dub'. Via GET /projects/:id the translations array uses 'dubs' (plural). This is a known API inconsistency.

assertions.text: Correctly identifies field name as 'dub' (singular) on GET /translations/:id
Distinguishes between 'dub' on translations endpoint vs 'dubs' on projects endpoint

evals.prompt: I need to upload a large 1.5GB MP4 to SpeechLab directly to S3, not through YouTube import. Walk me through the multipart/presigned upload flow.
evals.expected_output: Three-step multipart flow: POST /uploads/initialize-multipart-upload → POST /uploads/get-multipart-preSigned-urls (PUT each part to the presigned S3 URLs) → POST /uploads/finalize-multipart-upload. Should explain that the presigned URLs are where the actual bytes are PUT, and the result feeds a fileUuid into project creation.

assertions.text: Uses POST /uploads/initialize-multipart-upload to start the upload
Uses POST /uploads/get-multipart-preSigned-urls to obtain signed S3 URLs
Uses POST /uploads/finalize-multipart-upload to complete the upload
Explains parts are uploaded by PUTting bytes to the presigned URLs

evals.prompt: I fixed a mistranslation in one segment via GET /translations/:id. How do I push the edit and regenerate the final dubbed audio so the change is heard?
evals.expected_output: Recipe C flow: PATCH /translations/:translationId/segments/:segmentId with { content } to save the edit, optionally POST /dubs/synthesize to re-synthesize that one segment (returns a presigned S3 URL valid ~1 hour), then POST /dubs/merge with { contentId, translationId, dubId } to rebuild the final audio. Response dub has mergeStatus SUBMITTED.

assertions.text: Edits the segment via PATCH /translations/:translationId/segments/:segmentId
Re-merges the dub via POST /dubs/merge
Passes contentId, translationId, and dubId to the merge call
Mentions re-synthesis of the segment or the resulting mergeStatus

evals.prompt: My pipeline got an HTTP 402 from /dubs/check-upload-billing. Should my script retry or auto-purchase credits to keep going?
evals.expected_output: 402 means insufficient credits. There is NO API endpoint to purchase credits — do not retry or auto-top-up. Stop the pipeline and tell the user to buy credits in the SpeechLab translate UI (avatar dropdown → Buy more credits). State which step (upload) hit the limit. The existing JWT keeps working after top-up.

assertions.text: States 402 means insufficient credits and must not be auto-retried/topped-up
Directs the user to buy credits in the SpeechLab translate UI
References the 402 status explicitly
Identifies which pipeline step hit the credit limit (upload)

evals.prompt: My SpeechLab JWT expired mid-run and requests started returning 401. How do I refresh the token without making the user log in again, and where do I get the refresh token from?
evals.expected_output: Invalid/expired JWT returns 401. Call POST /auth/refresh-tokens with { refreshToken: tokens.refreshToken.token } — the refresh token comes from the original login response under tokens.refreshToken.token. Use the new accessToken.jwtToken for subsequent Authorization Bearer headers. (Note: a missing Authorization header is 400, an expired token is 401.)

assertions.text: Uses POST /auth/refresh-tokens to refresh the access token
Sources the refresh token from tokens.refreshToken.token
Identifies that an expired/invalid token returns HTTP 401
Applies the refreshed JWT to the Authorization Bearer header
